standard_prerequisites: Lemma lemma-flat-axioms (in-source definition carrier): defines property P (flatness of the relevant localizations) on WAdm^Noeth
Lemma lemma-finite-type-red and lemma-finite-type (in-source definition carriers): define properties Q and R
Formal Spaces, Lemma formal-spaces-lemma-completed-tensor-product: Noetherianity of the completed tensor under Q
Lemma lemma-Noetherian-finite-type-red (in-source): Q implies topologically finite type
Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-completion-flat: the completion of a finite type map is flat
standard completed-tensor quotient identity: A (tensor)_B C/J^n = (A (completed tensor)_B C)/J^n(...)
a limit lemma: a J-adically complete module whose quotients M/J^n M are flat over C/J^n is flat over C
core_obligations: Let P be the property defined in Lemma lemma-flat-axioms, Q the property of Lemma lemma-finite-type-red, R the property of Lemma lemma-finite-type, all on arrows of WAdm^Noeth. (1) P is stable under base change by Q. (2) P+R is stable under base change.
proof_roadmap: The completed tensor A (completed tensor)_B C is Noetherian whenever Q holds on either arrow (formal-spaces-lemma-completed-tensor-product); R implies Q by the named lemma, covering both cases.

Fix ideals of definition I and J. By lemma-Noetherian-finite-type-red, B -> C/J^n is of finite type, so A (tensor)_B C/J^n is Noetherian; it is flat over C/J^n as a base change of the P-flat B -> A, and its I-adic completion is flat over it by algebra-lemma-completion-flat.

The completed tensor M = A (completed tensor)_B C satisfies M/J^n M flat over C/J^n for all n (via the standard quotient identity) and is J-adically complete; the limit lemma concludes that C -> M is flat.
difficulty_reason: H2: a base-change stability theorem for a flatness property, discharged by a complete quotient-wise flatness chain with named carriers at each step.
